name: Bus::try_send / Bus::send

test_list.description: At capacity, try_send returns Full carrying the command back (never a silent drop).
After the receiver is dropped, try_send returns Closed with the command.
try_send works without an async runtime and returns immediately.
send().await completes once the consumer frees a slot.
proptest: any interleaving of try_send/try_recv preserves FIFO order.

inputs.name: cmd
inputs.description: Command from a UI or agent frame.

output_description: Queued, or rejected with the command handed back.
